A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FENCE evaluator and generator-training framework. All 16 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluator and generator experiments, augmentation-quality checks, ablations, and sensitivity analyses in Sections 3–4.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and reports additional Llama2-7B-chat, TruthfulQA, and Self-Eval-SKT experiments in Table 3.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same critique and source-document augmentation, knowledge-dependent correction/removal procedure, and SFT followed by DPO. E/R + Coarse abbreviates the existing Edit/Remove + Coarse method; additional backbone experiments do not introduce a new method.

E1.justification: v2 adds TruthfulQA training and evaluation across 38 categories, extending generator experiments beyond FActScore biography generation to truthful and informative question answering. The evaluator-training datasets and LLM-AggreFact coverage remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Generator Table 3 adds Self-Eval-SKT. Evaluator Table 1 adds MiniCheck-FT5 and removes PaLM2-Bison, using scores attributed to Tang et al. in both cases. FactTune-FS and EVER-Pref correspond to the previously evaluated FactTune and EVER procedures.

E3.justification: v2 adds Llama2-7B-chat configurations and a TruthfulQA protocol using three training examples per category, 703 test examples, generation-mode evaluation, and the benchmark's finetuned evaluator for % True*Info. The existing FActScore 400/100 split and LLM-AggreFact balanced-accuracy protocol are retained.

E4.justification: The evaluator ablations, augmentation-quality audit, popularity/topic breakdowns, revision and top-k sensitivity analyses, and appendix case studies are unchanged. v2 Table 4 separates the existing generator ablations from v1 Table 3 rather than adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, uncertainty intervals, or formal significance tests. Both retain point estimates and the same manual audit counts in Table 2.

E6.justification: v2 Table 3 newly reports Llama2 FActScore results, including 55.43% facts for the proposed method versus 38.57% for the base model, and TruthfulQA results of 56.47%/67.14% True*Info for the method with Llama2/Llama3. Self-Eval-SKT results are also added. Existing Llama3 FActScore results, including 65.41% for the method, are unchanged. Table 1 replaces PaLM2-Bison's 66.6 average with MiniCheck-FT5's 74.7, matching FENCE's average.

T1.justification: The claim-document mappings, label definitions, source-label reasoning, preference-pair count, and objectives in Equations 1–2 are unchanged. No new theorem, proof, or substantive derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The central evaluator and generator-training contributions remain the same. Headline efficacy claims expand to Llama2 and TruthfulQA. The newly emphasized 8.83-point FActScore advantage concerns Llama2; the retained Llama3 advantage remains 6.96 points.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning noisy WICE labels, lesser-known facts, refusal patterns, and revision saturation remain substantively unchanged. Section 7 also retains the now-outdated statement that generator experiments use only FActScore.

D1.justification: v2 omits the explicit FActScore input template, 'Tell me a bio of <entity>', provided in v1 Section 4.1. Appendix A's augmentation and retrieval parameters and Appendix B's split-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to TruthfulQA and Zhang et al.'s self-evaluation method, while removing the Tool-Augmented LLMs paragraph and seven associated references. The principal positioning against evaluator-training and factuality-finetuning research is retained; MiniCheck was already cited in v1.

P1.justification: v2 locally rewrites the abstract, introduction, and experimental discussion, combines dataset and metric descriptions, adjusts headings and method names, and removes the tool-related-work paragraph and acknowledgements. The overall section order and methodological narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: v1 Table 3 becomes an expanded model/benchmark comparison in v2 Table 3, with retained ablations separately displayed in Table 4. Table 1's grouping and layout are adjusted. The six figures and appendix displays are preserved, with limited spacing changes and table renumbering.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's Llama3/FActScore-only generator tests, v2 provides evidence across another backbone and TruthfulQA. Its joint truthfulness/informativeness metric usefully tests a method that can remove claims, and the additional baselines strengthen comparison. These benefits outweigh limited documentation regressions, but the unchanged FActScore-only limitation, Llama3-only appendix settings, and omitted biography prompt leave the expanded experiments incompletely documented.
